title: Cannot Be Destroyed
paragraphs: “Boo-boo-boo!”
“Rise up, people… or not. I wonder who tripped her… You’ve got some nerve saying that without knowing anything about Gaelion-chan’s struggles.”
“That’s right… I’m getting so fed up with Gaelion that I’m seriously considering just finishing her off in one go.”
“That’s like a summer insect flying into a flame! Right here, I’ll unleash the most powerful Magic I possess and wipe out the entire castle!”
Do you really think I’d give you the time to be so leisurely? Stop making a fool of me already.
“Spear Hero, for once we’re on the same page.”

Just then, I spotted Filolial-sama at Trash’s feet. He looks completely exhausted… Could this be Filolial-sama, who’s been waiting for us in Shieldfreeden!? This is… surely not… could Filolial-sama have been taken hostage too!?

“Heroes, I beg you to spare us! Not only are our nation’s leaders being held hostage, but even Filolial—whom you entrusted to us—is being held captive… They’ve warned that if we don’t summon you, they’ll kill the prisoners we captured to summon you, branding them as ‘Apostles of the Devil.’”
“They’re a bunch of cowards through and through.”
We can’t just burn the whole building down like this.

“‘Fully prepared’… as if. In other words, they have no intention of stopping this speech until we storm in… According to their logic, all the suspicious Filolials around the world won’t stop causing trouble until they’ve defeated us. They’re so well-prepared… I’m worried about what’s happening over in the Faubrey area.”
“There’s no doubt it’s a huge commotion over there, too.”
“Ugh, what a hassle… Hmm?”
The panda, who looked thoroughly fed up, seemed to have noticed something and was sniffing the air repeatedly.
“Hey… Naofumi.”
Sakura-chan seemed to feel the same way and called out to Father.
“Lars-chan, Sakura-chan, what’s wrong?”
“Um… I can smell Mel-chan!”
“I’m picking up a signal here too… It seems she’s close by.”
Hearing Sakura-chan’s words, Father furrowed his brow in distaste and turned his gaze toward the castle. In other words, her Finacées were over there.
“…Are the Princess of Melromarc and that boy, Fohl, inside that castle?”
“The Queen’s probably there too… Doesn’t this mean he’s gathered everyone who’s a threat to the heroes and turned it into an impregnable fortress?”
“Ugh… Those bastards…”

Their own children! To take even their Finacées hostage—I’m utterly appalled! They may be hopeless Trash, but I did at least respect the love they showed toward their family. I suppose that, in the end, was all it amounted to.

…What should I do? Admittedly, I find my Finacées utterly detestable, but they’re still Filo-tan and Sakura-chan’s best friends. If they were to get hurt, Filo-tan and Sakura-chan would be heartbroken. I can’t afford to make any mistakes. There’s no doubt I’ll kill those bastards in the most gruesome way possible, but for now, I should prioritize rescuing my Finacées.
“Doesn’t this just show that the Wise King of Wisdom has demonstrated his true capabilities?”
“King Aultcray… Have you really sunk that low…?”
Éclair said in a trembling voice, as if lamenting.
“So? What are we going to do?”

“Hmm… If we foolishly prioritize rescuing the hostages, they’ll probably outmaneuver us… But if the ‘Wise King of Wisdom’ I’ve heard about is seriously coming to crush us, he’s probably already figured us out… Does anyone have any ideas?”
“I’ll charge in head-on and slaughter every last one of those Trash and pigs!”
“Yeah. That’s typical of you, Motoyasu… but if we’re not careful, the people you care about might end up dying, so I want to be as cautious as possible.”
Ugh… Father has a point. Given everything that’s happened so far, they’ll definitely take Filolial-sama hostage. If that happens, we won’t be able to act recklessly.

“If we went so far as to slaughter everyone, hostages and all, that would play right into their hands… They want to spread the rumor that I’m a ruthless Demon King, so even if the leader dies, it could still damage the faith in the Hero…”

“We don’t need to gather in one place to respond to their summons. How about having Naofumi and the Spear Hero—the very people the enemy wants—go to their lair as representatives, while a separate task force works together to rescue the hostages in the meantime…?”

“It’s a safe bet, I suppose, but that does seem like the best plan… Well then, let’s assign roles. It seems like a safe bet to have the Hero, who’ll draw their attention, and the Dragon, the representative of Shieldfreeden, take the lead.”

“If we rescue the hostages, we can try to suppress them all at once… I wonder if that’ll work… Actually, since Motoyasu-kun is good at hiding, having him infiltrate and rescue the hostages might be a good option too…”
“Oo-oo-oo-ooh! Oo-oo-oo-ooh!”
The pig is making some kind of noise through a megaphone. I have no idea what’s going on.

“Motoyasu and I were clearly spotted earlier, after all. Since we’ve been called out by name, if Motoyasu tries to go undercover, we might just tip them off… And to top it off, they’ve even gone so far as to call Gaelion-chan.”
Ugh… It basically means I’m completely blocked from going undercover to save my Finacées. That Trash. Dealing with an enemy is this much of a hassle, isn’t it? I’ll make sure he gets his comeuppance!
“That’s true… Elmelo, can you get a clear view of the inside of the building from here?”
“That’s a bit tricky…”
“Then can you secure an escape route?”
Zou nods at Panda’s words. I wonder what they’re planning?
“Kou-san, I’d like you to join me in this operation. Is that okay?”
“Yeah. Got it.”
“It’s a bit like something the Spear Hero would do, but Lasa, if you can pull it off, you can do it anywhere—as long as you grow some bamboo, that is.”
“It’s settled, then.”
It seems there’s some plan only Panda and Zou understand.

“The knight, me, and my subordinate, Sakura, will sneak in to rescue the princesses. Meanwhile, the heroes and the Dragon will keep the terrorists and the Wise King occupied… I guess that’s the safest bet.”
“Yeah. Yuki-chan, please take care of Motoyasu-kun.”
“Understood.”
“I guess I have no choice.”

“Well then… I’ll use Magic to create a powerful cloak of invisibility for the infiltration team so they can hide. But even then, if they’re going to be discovered, they’ll be discovered, so be extremely careful.”
“Hmm… Lord Iwatani, Lord Kitamura, we’ll definitely live up to your expectations.”

So, we went back inside the tent for a moment to avoid being spotted by those pigs, and cast a powerful concealment spell on the pandas in the infiltration team. I don’t think those pigs will be able to find them now. This Magic can’t be dispelled with just any old Magic.
“Well then… let’s go in. We don’t know what’s coming, so don’t let your guard down.”
“Depending on the situation, we’ll take them out with a preemptive strike.”
The battle to take down those troublesome pigs and Trash has begun! And so, we set out to meet the leader of the remaining Takt forces and that Trash.
Responding to their summons, we entered the castle of Shieldfreeden. Debris was scattered here and there inside the castle. It seems there was a fierce battle here.
“Motoyasu, you know what to do, right?”
“Of course I do.”

We’ll walk as slowly as possible, maintaining a regal stride befitting a champion to buy time. After all, the infiltration team—led by Sakura-chan—is already on the move to rescue the hostages. If it weren’t for the hostages, I’d slaughter these bastards in a heartbeat.
“Oink-oink!”
The sound of a pig’s squeal comes from loudspeakers installed here and there, as if it were a castle-wide announcement.
“What a vulgar summons. Well… I suppose we should take it as a sign that they’re on their guard—since the women aren’t rushing at us recklessly…”
“It’s obvious right away they’re trying to lure us into a trap. Gaelion-chan and Yuki-chan, stay on high alert, too.”
“Yes, ma’am.”
“Just this once, Motoyasu-kun, will you stick to the plan?”
“I know, of course.”

Honestly, between how much of a hassle this is and my murderous intent toward the pigs and Trash, I’m dying to blow this whole building to smithereens. All I can think about is culling those pigs as soon as possible. Suppressing that murderous intent, we slowly made our way to what looked like a large assembly hall—or rather, a conference room. When we opened the door and stepped inside, the pig scum and Trash from the Takt remnants were waiting for us at the head of the table. Pigs were stationed here and there throughout the room as well. It looked like they were fully prepared. I hadn’t realized there were still so many Takt remnants left.
“You’re here, Shield! Spear!”

Trash said, glaring at us with eyes filled with murderous intent. I reflexively glared back at Trash with a look of murderous intent of my own. Since they’ve gone through with such a despicable scheme, I’ll definitely make them suffer slowly before I kill them!
“Well, well… Should I call you King Aultcray…? No, for the sake of Melromarc’s honor, perhaps I should call you the ‘Wise King of False Wisdom’?”
Father seems to have flipped a switch, responding in a provocative tone.
“We’re finding this welcome a bit too rough, if you ask us…”
“Bububu!”
Shut up, you pig! Yes, just as I glared at him with murderous intent, I was left speechless. These pigs… they look completely different from how they appeared in the footage.

Their clothing—from their vital areas outward—is swollen with countless… no, they’re wearing armor made of eggs strung together like prayer beads. What’s more, each of them carries eggs so they can produce them anywhere at will.
What on earth is that…!? They’re all Filolial-sama’s eggs!
“I’d considered that as a possibility, but I never thought they’d actually pull it off…”
“This is… far too underhanded. To exploit Lord Motoyasu’s weakness so precisely—fight fair and square!”
Rival is dumbfounded, and Yuki-chan is denouncing them.
“That’s cowardly! I can’t fight like this!”
……The Trash remained silent for about a minute, glaring with eyes filled with murderous intent, as if he meant to kill everyone. Eventually, he slowly opened his mouth.
“Hmph! How long I’ve been waiting for this day! You evil Demon Lords!”

“Demon Lords… huh. This is something else. The extremists who unleashed the Filolials across the globe and invaded Siltvelt, prioritizing their own ambitions over the world’s crisis—they really do talk a different language.”
The Trash’s cheek twitched as Father shot back, and he shook his fists violently as if trying to suppress his rage.

But more importantly, what’s the deal with all those Filolial-sama eggs attached all over your body, starting with those pigs!? With those, even an Aiming Lancer would shatter the eggs if it hit them carelessly. It’s a defensive barrier so thick that the Three Heroes Church’s “Filolial-sama Egg Hostage Strategy” doesn’t even hold a candle to it!
Eventually, suppressing his trembling body, Trash slowly answers.

“I’m not looking for salvation or anything like that! My only desire is to avenge the late Malty’s grievance, and to ensure you lot meet a gruesome end—and to put an end to that ridiculous legend about the ‘Shield Hero and Spear Hero’ once and for all!”
“So? And to do that, you’re going to kidnap your own family… and use the Filolial eggs as a shield to wipe us all out at once?”
“I’m under no obligation to go out of my way to reveal my strategy to you lot!”
“You really think that’ll work?”
I can tell Father, with that cold expression on his face, is breaking out in a cold sweat. To avoid giving himself away, he snaps back at that Trash.
“Bubub! Boo-boo! Bubub!”
The pig representing the remnants of the Takt faction is saying something.
“Hmph! Spear… If you value this egg so much, kill your shield right here and now, and then kill yourself. This isn’t… a warning. It’s an order!”
“What did you say!?”
“If you dare defy this order… you’ll be made an example of.”
“‘Bububu!’”
The pigs from Takt’s remnants all simultaneously pulled Filolial-sama’s eggs from their robes and pockets and aimed them at the ground—
“S-stop it, aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
With a resounding *clang*, Filolial-sama’s eggs shattered all at once, and their contents scattered everywhere.
“Youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”
It’s been since the first time Takt attacked me that such dark, seething emotions have welled up inside me like this!
“I will absolutely not forgive you!”
“Oops, do you really think these eggs will be okay after you attacked us?”
“Grrrrr…”
There are countless eggs of the Filolial-sama all around us.
“You’re far too well-prepared… I’m impressed that you’d go this far for the Spear Hero. Is this the Wise King of Wisdom…?”
“There’s not a shred of elegance to it, but there’s nothing better than this for hurting Motoyasu-sama…”
You are a thoroughly despicable creature, Wise King of Wisdom! I will definitely kill you in the most gruesome way possible! But for the sake of my loyalty, Filolial-sama… Father… ugh…
“Hahahahahaha… How utterly pathetic! Suffer some more!”
And then that Trash just kept laughing as he watched me writhe in agony.
“Hahahahahaha”

He’s been laughing for quite a while now! Does he really hold a grudge that long over the killing of a lowly Crimson Swine like that?! That scum is a scourge on the world! Killing him would be a righteous act—I’d be committing no crime at all!
“…Is that so?”
Seeing this, Father and Rival both tilted their heads in confusion.
